ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels covering approximately 85% of the surface area, with high-intensity white clusters localized at the distal tips and across the right lobe interior.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white patch on the left distal tip; complex array of white linear and curvilinear streaks across the central and lateral right lobe; small white punctate spots distributed across the central black field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 40 degrees and a pixel depth significant relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary exhibiting approximately 12-15 distinct peaks per lobe with variable amplitudes; higher frequency of jagged variations on the lateral distal portions of both trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple isolated white circular pixel clusters (<5 pixels in diameter) scattered across the lower medial black zones; dense mottled white texture on the far-left tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of parallel and intersecting white linear pixel disruptions on the right lobe, appearing as distinct rake marks against the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant notch/missing segment on the upper trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive linear scarring across the right fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive zig-zagging or chevron-shaped white pigmentation pattern located in the mid-section of the right lobe.
